title: Quantitative Pulmonary Imaging Registry & Biorepository
summary: The goal of this project is to establish a registry and biorepository of images and biological samples from subjects undergoing novel pulmonary imaging methods to be used for future research aimed toward identifying clinical applications of imaging methods and toward understanding the physiological significance of imaging biomarkers. This registry and biorepository will accelerate the development of these imaging techniques and may lead toward future clinical adoption of quantitative pulmonary imaging.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The participant is enrolling/has enrolled in a research study at the University of Kansas Medical Center that involves Pulmonary MRI and/or Pulmonary CT.

Exclusion Criteria:

* The participant declines to participate.
